risks.risk: Condition risk (used vs new; possible page damage, missing pages, water damage, or heavy wear) that affects resale value.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of 1 book’s front cover, spine, and the inside first page (and a photo of the back cover) showing condition clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used/unknown condition (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Copy-count risk: the photos show a stack, but not whether the seller can provide exactly 5 or 10 copies (and whether they are all distinct titles or duplicates).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the exact number of copies being offered for the 5-copy bundle and the 10-copy bundle laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a mixed bundle with uncertain availability/duplicates (worst case for matching what you expect).

risks.risk: Edition/format risk (paperback vs hardcover; different editions) which changes market value.
risks.proof: Ask for ISBN or edition/printing info photo from the copyright page of at least 2 representative books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used editions with unknown format.

risks.risk: Authenticity risk (possible reprints/unauthorized copies) that affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for ISBN + publisher name photo from the copyright page for 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially lower-value reprints/unknown authenticity.

proof_requests: Show the exact 5-book bundle laid out (count visible) and the exact 10-book bundle laid out (count visible).
Close-up condition photos: front cover, spine, back cover, and inside first page for at least 2 books.
Photo of the copyright/ISBN page for at least 2 books (to confirm edition/format).
response.reason: The photos confirm the general type (business/self-help books with readable titles), but they do not prove the exact bundle count, condition, edition/format, or authenticity—factors that strongly affect the price. Request the bundle-count and condition/ISBN proof first.
